system.name: Pie
system.one_liner: a programmable LLM serving system where user-provided WebAssembly inferlets control the generation process via fine-grained service handlers

components.name: Inferlet
components.role: user-provided program that controls the generation process via API calls

components.name: Inferlet Lifecycle Manager
components.role: manages inferlet lifecycles: creation, destruction, communication; launches inferlets via RPC

components.name: Controller
components.role: central controller that handles API calls from many concurrent inferlets

components.name: command queues
components.role: per-type queues used to group GPU API calls for batching

components.name: Batch scheduler
components.role: groups GPU API calls for performance efficiency and forwards them to the inference layer

components.name: Event dispatcher
components.role: receives and broadcasts results from the inference layer back to inferlets

components.name: API handler
components.role: specialized handler that executes a batched API call via GPU-side tensor operations

flows.what: RPCs for querying, submitting, and launching inferlets
GPU API calls grouped for the batch scheduler
results broadcast back to the inferlet

summary: Pie is a programmable LLM serving system that decomposes the generation loop into fine-grained service handlers, letting user-supplied WebAssembly 'inferlets' control generation logic instead of a monolithic loop. Figure 3 shows Pie's three-layer request path: in the application layer, the Inferlet Lifecycle Manager launches an Inferlet (step 1); the inferlet issues API calls into the control layer's Controller (step 2), which routes GPU calls into per-type command queues handled by a Batch scheduler (step 3); the batch scheduler forwards batched calls to inference-layer API handlers (step 4), which execute GPU work and return results through an Event dispatcher back up to the inferlet (step 5). Dashed lines separate the three layers, and gray boxes mark other, out-of-focus inferlets and handlers, while white boxes trace the numbered path of one call.
summary_zh: 图3展示Pie的三层（应用/控制/推理）请求流程：推理程序通过生命周期管理器启动，经控制器与批调度器排队，由推理层API处理器执行，结果经事件分发器返回，步骤以圈码1-5标注。
